name: TwoChat
description: Workspace chat (Slack-style): public channels, DMs, threads, reactions, pins, saved items, drafts, read state, attachments, notifications, and composed block messages (buttons, images, fields, task lists…) authored by humans AND agent bots — bots participate as first-class members via workspace API keys.

endpoints.name: listChannels
endpoints.description: Every visible channel + DM for the caller, each with unread count, member list and last-activity. The sidebar's single bootstrap call.

endpoints.name: createChannel
endpoints.description: Creates a group channel. `botIds` optionally adds agent participants at create time. Names are unique per workspace among kind=channel.

endpoints.name: getChannel
endpoints.description: One channel with members. Members (incl. bots) can read; membership is checked. Agents use this with their workspace API key.

endpoints.name: updateChannel
endpoints.description: Rename / re-topic / (un)archive / reorder a channel.

endpoints.name: deleteChannel
endpoints.description: Deletes a channel and (via FK cascade) its messages, members, pins and drafts.

endpoints.name: joinChannel
endpoints.description: Adds the caller (user or bot) to a channel. Bots use this to enter channels they participate in.

endpoints.name: leaveChannel
endpoints.description: Removes the caller from a channel.

endpoints.name: openDm
endpoints.description: Opens (or returns the existing) direct-message channel between the caller and the given users/bots. dm_key is the stable sorted actor set.

endpoints.name: listMessages
endpoints.description: Channel history, newest-last, keyset-paginated with `before` = "<createdAtISO>~<messageId>". Agents poll this to catch up.

endpoints.name: postMessage
endpoints.description: Posts a message. Body is plain `text` and/or composed `blocks` (markdown, image, button rows, fields, code, task-lists… — src/blocks.ts). Mentions in context blocks and @name text notify those users. Single-level replies via `replyToId` (clamped to thread roots).

endpoints.name: editMessage
endpoints.description: Edits your own message (text and/or blocks). Sets editedAt.

endpoints.name: deleteMessage
endpoints.description: Soft-deletes your own message (text/blocks cleared, tombstone kept for reply integrity).

endpoints.name: toggleReaction
endpoints.description: Toggles the caller's emoji reaction on a message; returns the full reaction summary.

endpoints.name: invokeMessageAction
endpoints.description: Invokes a button on a bot-authored composed message. The click is persisted to that bot's durable action inbox and broadcast as twochat.message.action, so agents can process it online or later.

endpoints.name: togglePin
endpoints.description: Pins/unpins a message in its channel.

endpoints.name: toggleSaved
endpoints.description: Adds/removes a message from the caller's saved-for-later list.

endpoints.name: listPins
endpoints.description: Pinned messages of a channel, newest pin first.

endpoints.name: listSaved
endpoints.description: Everything the caller saved, across channels.

endpoints.name: getDraft
endpoints.description: The caller's unsent draft text for a channel (empty string when none).

endpoints.name: saveDraft
endpoints.description: Persists the caller's draft for a channel (survives reloads/tab switches).

endpoints.name: markRead
endpoints.description: Advances the caller's read cursor for a channel (also arrives over WS as a `read` frame).

endpoints.name: uploadAssets
endpoints.description: Multipart upload of one or more files into a channel. Stored via the storage adapter (TwoDrive S3 stub / local fs today). Returns asset payloads to embed as attachment blocks.

endpoints.name: getAsset
endpoints.description: Streams an attachment's bytes (auth-checked; blobs are never publicly addressed).

endpoints.name: listAssets
endpoints.description: Files shared in a channel.

endpoints.name: listBots
endpoints.description: Agent/bot participants of the workspace (name, avatar emoji, kind).

endpoints.name: createBot
endpoints.description: Registers a bot participant. `apiKeyId` binds a workspace API key (from TwoDB control plane) so the agent can post via /bots/webhook.

endpoints.name: botWebhook
endpoints.description: THE agent participation endpoint. Auth = workspace API key bound to a bot. Posts a composed message (blocks or text) into `channelId`/`channelName`, auto-joins the bot to the channel, fans out over WS and notifies mentioned users — identical treatment to human messages. This is how agents become chat citizens: they read via listMessages and reply via this.

endpoints.name: listBotActions
endpoints.description: Durable inbox of interactive message button clicks addressed to the calling bot. Unacknowledged only by default.

endpoints.name: acknowledgeBotAction
endpoints.description: Marks one interactive-message action processed by the calling bot.

endpoints.name: listNotifications
endpoints.description: The caller's notification inbox (mentions, DMs, bot posts) with unread count.

endpoints.name: markNotificationRead
endpoints.description: Marks one notification read.

endpoints.name: markAllNotificationsRead
endpoints.description: Marks the whole inbox read.

endpoints.name: search
endpoints.description: Full-text-ish message search (ILIKE over the text projection) feeding the Gateway's federated search fan-out.
